notes.title: 🎴 For Fans of Scoundrel… Meet Baazi
notes.content:
[p]If you’ve ever braved the dungeon of Scoundrel by Zach Gage and Kurt Bieg, you already know the thrill of turning a deck of cards into a deadly puzzle.[/p][p] [/p][p]Baazi is built from that same brutal foundation—refined, expanded, and sharpened.[/p][p]
🔪 What's New in Baazi[/p][p]
Scoring Teeth – Add up the numbers on every monster, weapon, and potion you actually spent.[/p][p]
Endless Descent Mode – For those who master the core dungeon and want infinite pain.[/p][p]
Global Leaderboards – Compare delves, prove survival, and tempt fate again.[/p][p]
Daily Descent  – one shared dungeon seed —beat the same brutal layout as everyone else.[/p][p]
Rules Modifier –  Enable Vampire, Blacksmith, Shatterbrand and/or Baazigar. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647925/ec9fd45f4089432fee852ed158482e3e4fe23d98.png"][/img]

Baazi pays homage to Scoundrel, while forging a path of its own.[/p][p]
The deck is waiting. Ready to play?
[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update: Speed Boosts, Fixes & More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! A small but mighty update just dropped, focused on polish and quality-of-life improvements:

🔁 Same Seed Bug – This was bad, I take full responsibility.

⚡ Faster Animations – Core game animations have been sped up to keep the action flowing.

🐢 Card Follow Lag – Fixed an issue where cards couldn’t keep up if you were super fast. They’re snappier now!

🪲 Undo Bug Squashed – Monster damage wasn’t calculated properly after undoing moves. That’s been fixed.

As always, thanks for the feedback! If something still feels off—or if you just want to share your high scores—drop by the discussions 👇

Happy delving,– Sanchit

notes.title: “Score 2.0” Arrives – Every Action Counts!
notes.content:
[p]Hey adventurers![/p][p]The old “start high, subtract everything” system was… well, a buzz-kill. So we flipped it:[/p][list][*][p][b]Weighted Upsides[/b] – Monsters (+10 pts × value), Weapons (+5), Potions (+8) and every HP you finish with (+2).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Light Penalty[/b] – Only –2 pts per damage taken. Skill still matters, but you’re no longer punished for playing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full Transparency[/b] – End-screen shows the exact math, including card values and multipliers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Retroactive Achievements[/b] – Escape with the Baazigar deck? You’ll now see the shiny badge pop![/p][/*][/list][p]Update is live—shuffle a fresh deck, try a speed-run, or push for that perfect-health clear. We can’t wait to see the monster-mashing, potion-gulping high scores you put up![/p][p]See you in the dungeon,
— The Baazi Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Baazi’s Big UI Overhaul Is Here!
notes.content: [p]We’ve just rolled out a major UI overhaul for [b]Baazi[/b], and we’re excited for you to check it out. This update brings a [i]sleeker, more readable[/i], and [i]tactically focused[/i] interface to the game, all wrapped in our signature minimalist brutalist aesthetic.[/p][h3]What’s New:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Redesigned HUD[/b]: Cleaner layout that puts your most important decisions front and center.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sharper Cards[/b]: Clearer typography and iconography to help you read the battlefield at a glance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Snappier Interactions[/b]: Faster animations and improved input feedback for a more responsive feel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Polish Pass[/b]: Visual and layout improvements across menus, tooltips, and in-game elements.[/p][/*][/list][p]This update was shaped by player feedback and long hours of testing—thank you to everyone who's helped us sharpen Baazi into the game it’s becoming.[/p][p]If you haven’t played in a while, now’s a perfect time to dive back in. And if you're new—there's never been a better time to start flipping cards and fighting fate.[/p][p]Let us know what you think in the Community Hub or Discord![/p]
